title: Rainbow Ring
description: The first time you play an Attack, Skill, and Power each turn, gain 1 Strength and 1 Dexterity.
flavor: Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...
notes: Requires playing at least one Attack, one Skill, and one Power in the same turn to trigger. Only activates once per turn. Both effects (Strength and Dexterity) are granted simultaneously.
